infrastructureRules: A Claude wrapper telemetry record with claudeExitCode != 0 is an executor infrastructure failure and is excluded from scientific outcomes.
A timed-out command agent is an executor infrastructure failure and is excluded from scientific outcomes.
The matrix must stop immediately on the first infrastructure failure.
The failed cell index is not advanced; rerunning the same command retries exactly that scheduled cell.
Successful prior cells remain checkpointed and are not rerun during infrastructure resume.
The frozen schedule and baseline order do not change across resume operations.
The final scientific summary is emitted only after every scheduled cell has produced an analyzable outcome.
freezeRules: v0.3.1 changes execution accounting/checkpointing only; ontology, TaskPacks, graders, stateRequirements, worker profiles, matcher weights, context mappings, and role-selector semantics are unchanged from v0.3.
No scientific design parameter may change after a valid v0.3.1 real-agent outcome is inspected.
v0.2 remains a separate prospective null/ceiling result.
The aborted v0.3 attempt remains visible as infrastructure-invalid rather than being silently deleted.
